# TOON conformance fixtures

Copied unmodified from the Token-Oriented Object Notation specification repository,
`https://github.com/toon-format/spec` (`tests/fixtures/`, specification version 4.4,
fetched 2026-11-08). They are MIT licensed; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). `tests/test_toon.py`
runs every fixture against `scripts/improve_toon.py`.
